## Network Administrator
## Position Overview
We are looking for a skilled and proactive Network Administrator to join our team and play a key role in maintaining the integrity, performance, and security of our organisation's network infrastructure. The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience in network administration, a methodical approach to troubleshooting, and the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly across all levels of the business. This role suits a detail-oriented professional who thrives in a dynamic environment and is committed to delivering reliable, efficient IT services.
## Key Responsibilities
- Install, configure, and maintain network hardware, software, servers, and workstations, ensuring systems are kept up to date and performing optimally
- Monitor network performance on an ongoing basis, identifying and resolving issues proactively to minimise disruption to business operations
- Diagnose and troubleshoot network faults, emergencies, and connectivity issues, documenting resolutions and maintaining accurate records of all incidents and modifications
- Develop, maintain, and update procedures and documentation for network inventory, configuration changes, and maintenance instructions
- Manage user accounts, access permissions, and password policies in line with the organisation's security standards and compliance requirements
- Provide network programming and scripting support to address specific business needs and improve the efficiency of network operations
- Administer and support servers, printers, and personal computers, ensuring hardware resources remain reliable and fit for purpose
- Evaluate and implement upgrades to network infrastructure, recommending improvements that align with business growth and evolving technology requirements
- Deliver helpdesk support and technical assistance to end users, resolving issues in a timely manner and escalating complex problems where necessary
- Conduct user training and produce clear guidance materials to build internal capability and promote best practice use of network systems
- Maintain network security protocols, including firewall management, intrusion detection, and vulnerability assessments, to safeguard organisational data and systems
- Collaborate with internal stakeholders and external vendors to coordinate service delivery, procurement, and project implementation
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- Bachelor's degree or diploma in Information Technology, Computer Science, Network Engineering, or a related discipline
- Proven experience in a network administration or systems administration role within a corporate or enterprise environment
- Strong working knowledge of networking protocols, infrastructure components, and technologies including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, LAN/WAN, and firewalls
- Demonstrated experience installing, configuring, and managing servers, switches, routers, and associated network hardware
- Proficiency in network monitoring and diagnostic tools, with the ability to analyse performance data and respond to anomalies
- Solid understanding of network security principles, including access control, patch management, and risk mitigation
- Experience maintaining technical documentation, network inventories, and fault resolution records to a high standard
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to work methodically under pressure
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain technical issues to non-technical stakeholders
- Ability to manage competing priorities, work independently, and contribute effectively within a collaborative team environment
## Preferred Qualifications
- Industry certifications such as Cisco CCNA/CCNP, CompTIA Network+, Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator, or equivalent
- Experience with virtualisation platforms such as VMware or Hyper-V
- Familiarity with cloud-based infrastructure and hybrid network environments
- Experience working within ITIL frameworks or other structured IT service management methodologies
- Exposure to scripting or automation tools such as PowerShell, Python, or Ansible to streamline network operations
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a supportive, forward-thinking team that values continuous learning and invests in your professional development through training and certification opportunities
- Enjoy genuine flexibility with a structured work schedule that promotes a healthy work-life balance
- Work on diverse and challenging infrastructure projects that will broaden your technical expertise and keep your skills at the cutting edge
- Join an organisation with a strong culture of collaboration, where your contributions are recognised and your ideas are encouraged
- Competitive remuneration package with long-term career pathways and opportunities for progression within a growing business
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Superannuation

If your client gave you free-range to pick your tech stack, what would you do with it? What would you do if you had a new challenge every day? How would you feel if you could impact people's lives through tech?

Established over eighteen years ago, we are a growing Melbourne-based Software Consultancy with a core focus of delivering business-critical digital products to our clients. Our teams work alongside our customers to dissect their complex problems and convert them into value-driven solutions, combining innovative principles in development, design, analysis and quality automation. We utilise Design Thinking and Agile practices to rapidly create customer and business first software, testing and embracing new technologies and trends along the way.

Our Consultants become trusted advisors to our clients, working alongside other client stakeholders to ensure delivery and technical excellence. As a Fabric Consultant, you will lead by example and work hands-on alongside your teammates on delivery - as well as providing high-level guidance and advice to our customers.

Your key responsibilities as a Senior / Lead Consultant - Native Mobile Developer at Fabric:

-Work under autonomy with a self-driven attitude to own problems and deliver solutions
-Understand the complex business and technical problems, learn quickly, understand tradeoffs and communicate a solution
-Capability to research alternative solutions and propose them within given constraints
-Apply different languages and technologies to your projects while coding side by side with other developers on your team
-Implementing continuous delivery practices to accelerate the delivery of new valuable functionality to its intended users
-Applying test-driven development practices to ensure high quality of the software, and reduce future effort and cost on implementing changes to the product
-Mentoring and coaching less experienced mobile engineers in Fabric family and in our clients’ tech teams, hosting tech meetups and our community events to share your expertise with others
-Advising our clients on the right technical decisions and advocating for the right practices to use
-Being an ambassador for Fabric, promoting our values and the practices we use to make sure we build the software right
-Participate in interviewing and recruitment based on business needs
-Generate thought leadership content relevant to your role to support our marketing department in social media activities and meetups
-Write maintainable, efficient, and scalable code, rigorously adhering to Android coding standards and best practice
-Optimize existing systems for performance, scalability, and reliability, identifying and resolving bottlenecks and inefficiencies
-Take full ownership of assigned projects or components, proactively identifying areas for improvement and leading technical discussions to enhance solutions
-Provide guidance to junior engineers, sharing expertise to foster a collaborative and high-performing team environment
-Participate actively in architectural and design decisions, demonstrating a strong grasp of software design principles and scalability
-Seek out growth opportunities to deepen technical expertise and keep the team informed of emerging best practices

The skills you would need to be a Senior / Lead Consultant - Native Mobile Developer:
??
Minimum Qualifications:

-7+ years of hands-on experience in Mobile Software Engineering, focusing on scalable architecture and development
-Proficiency in developing for the Android Platform and frameworks relevant to the role
-Experience in the complete Android Development lifecycle, from design, testing, signing, releasing, fixing and beyond
-Understanding of Android’s design principles and interface guidelines
-Demonstrated experience providing technical leadership, mentoring, and guiding teams.
-Strong problem-solving skills and ability to tackle complex technical challenges.
-Excellent communication skills for effective collaboration across teams and stakeholders.
-Strong ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Your key benefits of being a part of the Fabric team:

-A variety of business domains to dive into including retail, finance, construction and logistics
-Creating innovative custom products to solve complex problems that existing solutions just can’t
-Collaborating with a team of top notch professionals who are obsessed with value, latest tech and the right way to build a digital product
-Ability to switch projects every 6-12 months to keep you challenged, excited and growing
-Strong support network from the delivery community of practice, leadership and our tech teams to help you address any client challenges you may face
-Very diverse and inclusive environment where people value feedback, connections and collaboration in a workspace
-Great office in CBD with all the amenities (yet you’re welcome to work remotely on most days!), fun team events, lunches and celebrations

MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Monash Health exists to reimagine care, so that people can live their best lives. 











We provide safe and equitable care, for every stage of life, delivered with world-leading expertise and over 175 years of experience. 











As a leading academic health service, we're committed to providing tomorrow's care today by integrating research, teaching and training into everyday practice. 







Our team of 24,000 people are full hearted, open minded and all in. Together, we provide more than 250 integrated services for every stage of life at over 50 locations and in the community across south-east Melbourne, Victoria, serving 1.2 million residents in the South Metro Local Health Service Network. 











To see first-hand what our colleagues think about working here, take a look at the following short videos monashhealth.org-careers. 








Help shape the future of healthcare at Monash Health and embark on a rewarding career where your dedication makes a difference in people's lives.



About the Department - Program
Monash Health Pharmacy is a diverse and dynamic team of over 500 professionals. We work across seven hospitals and community settings, delivering best-practice pharmacy services and supporting career development through structured rotations, mentoring, and leadership opportunities. 



About the Role
Join our team as a Pharmacy Student Research Project Assistant on a full time fixed-term (4 week) basis, to work at across our Monash Health sites. In this role, you will undertake allocated tasks as a research project assistant under pharmacist supervision. 



Key responsibilities include



Assist with pharmacy research projects under pharmacist supervision.


Collect and review patient, carer, health professional, and medical record data to support research activities.


Maintain compliance with legislative, professional, infection control, workplace safety, and quality standards.


Contribute to quality improvement and safe patient care while undertaking additional duties as required.




About You
To be successful in this healthcare role, you will bring the following demonstrated skills, experience, and attributes:



Strong organisational and problem-solving skills


Excellent communication and interpersonal skills


Works well with peers and supervisors showing flexibility and adaptability


Proactive, constructive and creative approaches to problem solving


Valid Driver's licence (desirable)




Mandatory requirements of the role

Work type: Part time

Southern Adelaide Local Health Network - Flinders Medical Centre- Cardiology

Salary $130,190 - $136,010 p.a. (Pro Rata) RN-M2A | Ongoing Part Time Position, 19 Hours Per Week 

Help Hearts Recover -Associate Nurse Unit Manager, Cardiac Rehab 

This part-time ongoing role at Flinders Medical Centre places you at the centre of cardiac recovery, leading rehabilitation care for patients rebuilding their health after a cardiac event. Working within the Southern Adelaide Local Health Network, you will bring specialist nursing expertise to a multidisciplinary team that genuinely values clinical leadership and person-centred practice. It is a rare opportunity to combine consultancy-level autonomy with the kind of patient impact that makes a lasting difference.

About the role: 

Reporting to the Nurse Unit Manager, you will lead the delivery of evidence-based cardiac rehabilitation, providing specialist clinical assessment, patient education, and expert consultation across the multidisciplinary team at Flinders Medical Centre.

Duties for the role will include:

Ensure that service provision and the activities of the Division - Unit - Ward - Service are person and family centred and professionally and effectively conducted by contributing to the development of an integrated team approach and culture which is highly responsive to the needs of our consumers,

Provide proficient, person centred, clinical nursing-midwifery care and-or individual case management to patients-clients in a defined clinical area,

Monitoring patient-client care plans to ensure appropriate care outcomes are achieved on a daily basis,

Assists and supports the Nurse-Midwife Unit Manager or equivalent in management, clinical, and education activities,

Plan and coordinate services including those from other disciplines

About you:

 Registered or eligible for registration as a Nurse by the Nursing and Midwifery Board of Australia and who holds, or who is eligible to hold, a current practicing certificate,

Effective communication, problem solving, conflict resolution and negotiation skills,

Registered Nurse-Midwife with at least 3 years, full time equivalent, post registration experience, or currently practicing as a Clinical Nurse,

Demonstrated competence in Acute nursing and Cardiac Nursing practice in accordance with the relevant standards

Please see the attached Role Description for additional information.
